adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference was changed from a single .find(...) to a .filter(...) and iterated via `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when a matching credential isn’t found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` per reference. This is verifiably sequential DB querying within the loop and could be optimized by collecting credentialIds and doing a single `findMany` (or preloading) to avoid N round-trips. This is a performance/efficiency concern rather than a correctness defect.
